channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jodie Meeks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jodie Meeks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Jodie Meeks
item.description:
Bobby Portis on Jodie Meeks:

“I don’t like that he said I didn’t abide by the rules. In what basketball world does it say just let a man go lay the ball up? He said, if a man has a clear path to the lane just let him lay it up. Where I’m from, that’s not basketball.”

Bobby Portis on Jodie Meeks, Feb 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Jodie Meeks
item.description:
#PistonsStan Van Gundy on @DSports1051 on Jodie Meeks:

“Jodie can help us in situations where we need scoring; he's a guy who could be viable for us.”

Stan Van Gundy on Jodie Meeks, Apr 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Jodie Meeks
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Kobe on Jodie Meeks competing for time in camp:

“That's not fair. Jodie has to guard me every day in practice so he ain't looking too good.”

Kobe Bryant on Jodie Meeks, Oct 11, 2012. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.
